_about: Medians of assay records in the radiopurity.org Material Assay Database (J.C. Loach et al., Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 839 (2016) 6-11), retrieved 2026-11-15 by searching all records and grouping them by material keyword. iso: [median of measured values (Bq/kg), number measured, median of upper limits (Bq/kg), number of limits]. ppm/ppb values converted with radiopurity.org factors (1 ppm U = 12.3 Bq/kg 238U, 1 ppm Th = 4.07 Bq/kg, 1 ppm K = 31.0 mBq/kg 40K). refs: data set (grouping) | publication, as given in each record.
